Name: SIGN_PUDDLE_SUB_CATEGORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Subcategories (headings) of the summoning pool map list. A pool points here with its Subcategory ID; its subcategory's Tab ID decides the tab it's listed in. In a tab, each subcategory's heading comes first, followed by its pools in their Sort Order in Subcategory.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Heading text of the subcategory, from Menu Text. Below 0: no heading is shown, but its pools are still listed.

Fields.Name: Tab ID
Fields.Description: The SignPuddleTabParam row this subcategory and its pools are listed in.

Fields.Name: Sort Order in Tab
Fields.Description: Order of this subcategory within its tab, ascending.
